entries.name: Hugging Face LeRobot Humanoid
entries.desc: Open-source humanoid platform under the LeRobot project.

entries.name: LeRobot Humanoid Hardware
entries.desc: BOM, STL files, and wiring/assembly docs for the LeRobot humanoid platform (Apache-2.0).

entries.name: K-Scale Z-Bot / K-Bot
entries.desc: DIY open-source humanoid — no vendor currently sells an assembled unit.

entries.name: Xiaomi CyberDog 2
entries.desc: Open-source quadruped platform with public ROS2 stack.

entries.name: Petoi Bittle X
entries.desc: Built on the OpenCat open-source quadruped framework.

entries.name: Petoi Quaddle
entries.desc: Also built on the OpenCat open-source framework.

entries.name: MangDang Mini Pupper 2 Pro
entries.desc: Open-source ROS robot dog kit.

entries.name: SO-100
entries.desc: Open-source 6-axis arm, native Hugging Face LeRobot support.

entries.name: SO-101
entries.desc: Successor to SO-100, same open-source LeRobot lineage.

entries.name: Elephant Robotics myCobot 280
entries.desc: Open-source 6-axis collaborative arm, Python/ROS support.

entries.name: Waveshare RoArm-M2-S
entries.desc: Open hardware + firmware desktop arm kit.

entries.name: Annin Robotics AR4
entries.desc: Open-source 6-axis arm, machined or 3D-printed at home.

entries.name: ROBOTIS Open-Manipulator-X
entries.desc: ROBOTIS's official open-source manipulator platform.

entries.name: Arctos Robotics Arm
entries.desc: 3D-printable open-source 6-axis arm.

entries.name: AlohaMini
entries.desc: Open-source 3D-printable dual-arm mobile robot, LeRobot-native.

entries.name: LeKiwi
entries.desc: Low-cost open-source holonomic mobile manipulator base.

entries.name: Linorobot2
entries.desc: Open-source ROS2 framework for DIY autonomous mobile robots.

entries.name: Otto DIY Maker Kit
entries.desc: Open-source 3D-printed bipedal robot kit with open hardware, firmware, and app.

entries.name: TurtleBot4 / Clearpath TurtleBot
entries.desc: ROS 2 educational/research robot with its full navigation, drivers, and simulation stack open-sourced — software only; hardware is a closed commercial build on the iRobot Create 3 base.

entries.name: Waveshare UGV Rover Series
entries.desc: Raspberry Pi/ESP32-powered tracked rover chassis with open firmware and demo code for motion control, ROS, and AI-camera vision — hardware is documented but not formally open-licensed.

entries.name: Valetudo Map Card for Home Assistant
entries.desc: Community Lovelace card rendering live Valetudo map/zone data inside Home Assistant dashboards.

entries.name: CHAMP Locomotion Profiles for Unitree Go2
entries.desc: Community-tuned gait/locomotion config profiles adapting the CHAMP quadruped controller to Go2 hardware.

entries.name: Worx Landroid Home Assistant Automation Recipe
entries.desc: Community integration recipe (via the Landroid Cloud HACS integration) for scheduling and monitoring Worx Landroid mowers from Home Assistant.

entries.name: Wire-Pod Local LLM Hook Recipes
entries.desc: Community configuration recipes wiring Wire-Pod's chat intent into locally-hosted LLMs instead of a cloud API.

entries.name: LeRobot Teleoperation Calibration Presets
entries.desc: Community-shared calibration presets for teleoperating and training SO-100/SO-101 arms with Hugging Face LeRobot.

entries.name: Valetudo
entries.desc: Open-source, cloud-free local control layer for supported LiDAR robot vacuums (Dreame, Roborock), replacing vendor clouds with local HTTP/MQTT.

entries.name: Wire-Pod (Digital Dream Labs Vector 1.0 & 2.0)
entries.desc: Community-maintained local server bypass for Vector's voice/cloud features, an alternative to the official subscription.

entries.name: OpenMoxie
entries.desc: Community-developed local server framework restoring conversational function to Embodied Moxie units after the official cloud shut down.

entries.name: OpenMower
entries.desc: Open-source firmware and carrier board converting perimeter-wire mowers (e.g. YardForce Classic 500) into wire-free, RTK-accurate autonomous mowers.

entries.name: Unitree SDK2 (unitree_sdk2_python)
entries.desc: Official local control SDK for Unitree Go2 and G1, built on CycloneDDS — no vendor app required.

entries.name: AiboHack RCode (legacy Sony Aibo ERS-210/220/31x)
entries.desc: Long-running community hacking framework for extending autonomous behavior on legacy Aibo memory-stick models.
